annotations.title: Put a Video on the Editor Timeline

description: Put a finished video on your Switch Editor project's timeline from its https link (an InVideo export, a Switch render, any video you own). It lands at the end of the timeline and in the project's media, ready to play and export. Spends no tokens.

name.description: A short name for the clip on the timeline.

seconds.description: Its length in seconds, if you know it.

url.description: The https link to the video file.
